See CLAUDE.md §2.');process.exit(2)}}catch(e){}})"

node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.command)||'';if(/git\s+push.*\b(main|master)\b/.test(cmd)||/gh\s+pr\s+merge.*--admin/.test(cmd)){console.error('[hook] main 직커밋/admin merge 차단. node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const p=(j.tool_input&&j.tool_input.file_path)||'';if(/(^|\/)vault\/02_wiki\/topics\/.+\.md$/.test(p)){const queueDir='.claude/queue';if(!fs.existsSync(queueDir))fs.mkdirSync(queueDir,{recursive:true});const queue=path.join(queueDir,'graph.txt');const rel=p.replace(process.cwd()+'/','');fs.appendFileSync(queue,rel+'\n');console.error('[hook] graph queue: '+rel)}}catch(e){}})"

bash -lc 'echo "=== cc-llm-wiki ==="; git status --short 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; echo "drafts: $(find vault/02_wiki/_drafts -name \"*.md\" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d \" \")"; echo "raw new (last 24h): $(find vault/01_raw -name \"*.md\" -mtime -1 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d \" \")"'
